title: assessment_planner respects run.autonomous_intrusive_allowed; stop gating exec_plan when operator opted-in
goal: The assessment_planner statically marks every intrusive-tier capability as NEEDS_APPROVAL — even when the run has `autonomous_intrusive_allowed=True`. This blocks the AI picker from queuing the exec_plan / impacket / metasploit / netexec / credential_attacks / file_upload-RCE chains the Mythos design depends on. Empirically confirmed on live Gruyere 2026-05-18 (run 9f951a0f): 24 picker reasonings, 0 exec_plan picks, picker falls back to random residual tools (ai-shell / c2-ingest / graphql / iot-default-creds), stops at max_iterations_reached, 0/17 known Gruyere classes found.
scope: Single-file fix in `api/app/services/assessment_planner.py`. Thread `run.autonomous_intrusive_allowed` from `build_assessment_plan_for_run` into `_score_capability`. When intrusive-tier AND `autonomous_intrusive_allowed=True`, the decision falls through the SAME evidence-driven logic as active/passive (RUN if triggers match, WAIT if weak, SKIP if blockers). Only when intrusive-tier AND NOT allowed do we still emit NEEDS_APPROVAL. Update the `_decision_sentence` to drop 'Controlled proof work needs the explicit approval gate' for the allowed-intrusive path.
generation_reason: Live Gruyere run 9f951a0f produced 0/17 known vulnerability classes despite ai_loop + autonomous_intrusive_allowed=True. Root cause traced to assessment_planner._score_capability lines 277-279: 'if risk_tier in INTRUSIVE_TIERS: decision = NEEDS_APPROVAL' — no consultation of the run flag. The picker (Claude Opus) reads the correct INTRUSIVE-AUTHORIZED system-prompt block; the planner overrides it. Operator pushback 2026-05-18: 'het onderliggende systeem werkt niet goed en reliable... had naar mijn idee een fluitje van een cent moeten zijn'. This is one of the 3 root-cause bugs identified during the live diagnosis.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Single-function refactor + tests only. Do NOT add new capability tiers, do NOT change INTRUSIVE_TIERS set membership, do NOT modify the system prompt's intrusive-tier block (it's already correct), do NOT touch workers/runners or workers/orchestration.
constraints.preserve_approval_path: When autonomous_intrusive_allowed=False, NEEDS_APPROVAL semantics must remain unchanged — existing approval workflows + audit events must keep working.
constraints.audit_trail: Every plan item that runs an intrusive runner under the auto-allowed path must carry an audit-event field documenting `autonomous_intrusive_allowed=True` so post-hoc reviewers can see which decisions used the bypass.

success_criteria: When autonomous_intrusive_allowed=True, intrusive-tier capabilities with matched triggers decide RUN (not NEEDS_APPROVAL).
When autonomous_intrusive_allowed=False, intrusive-tier capabilities still decide NEEDS_APPROVAL (existing contract preserved).
Live test against juice-shop/testfire with autonomous_intrusive_allowed=True: at least 1 exec_plan task gets queued during a 20-advance run (currently: 0).
Unit tests cover: allowed+triggered → RUN; allowed+blocker → SKIP; allowed+no_triggers → WAIT; not_allowed+anything → NEEDS_APPROVAL.
AgentReasoning.thought_text for an allowed-intrusive run no longer contains the 'Controlled proof work needs the explicit approval gate' template.

acceptance_criteria: Intrusive-tier capabilities decide RUN under autonomous_intrusive_allowed=True.
Approval workflow unchanged for non-allowed runs.
Audit-event field documents the auto-allowed path.
